title: Pagination
description: A pagination control with page buttons, rows-per-page selector, ellipsis, and customizable navigation icons.

siblingCount.description: The most sibling page buttons shown on each side of the current page. When the page row would overflow its container, Pagination shows fewer, down to none, keeping the first, current and last pages with ellipses between; then it tightens the list's spacing; then the page buttons' padding; and if even that does not fit, the page list scrolls inside the row while prev and next stay on it. The server and first render show the full set.

rowsPerPage.description: Current number of rows displayed per page.

rowOptions.description: Available row-per-page options for the selector.

onValueChange.description: (page: number) => void - Fires when the current page changes.

defaultValue.description: Initial page number for uncontrolled usage.

onRowsPerPageChange.description: (rows: number) => void - Fires when the rows-per-page value changes.

showRowsPerPage.description: Whether to show the rows-per-page selector.

rowsPerPageSuffix.description: Visible text after the rows-per-page select ("Show 10 rows"). With the prefix, it names the select; with both empty the select is named "Rows per page".

rowsPerPagePrefix.description: Visible text before the rows-per-page select. With the suffix, it names the select; the number is its value.

dropdownAriaLabel.description: Accessible label for the rows-per-page dropdown.

dropdownSide.description: Vertical placement of the rows-per-page dropdown — opens upward (top) or downward (bottom).

dropdownOffset.description: Gap in pixels between trigger and dropdown.

dropdownIcon.description: ReactNode — Replaces the rows-per-page select's chevron. Rendered as given; `classes.rowsPerPage.icon` styles the default one.

prevIcon.description: ReactNode — Replaces the previous-page arrow. Rendered as given; `classes.navIcon` styles the default one.

nextIcon.description: ReactNode — Replaces the next-page arrow. Rendered as given; `classes.navIcon` styles the default one.

renderEllipsis.description: (props: EllipsisRenderProps) => ReactNode - Custom render function for the ellipsis element.

renderPageInfo.description: (props: PageInfoRenderProps) => ReactNode - Custom render function for the page info display.

reduceMotion.description: Controls motion preferences. 'auto' respects the user's OS setting.

classes.description: CSS class overrides for pagination sub-elements.

portalContainer.description: HTMLElement | null - Portal target for the rows-per-page dropdown.

keepMounted.description: Keeps the rows-per-page menu mounted while closed.

prevAriaLabel.description: Accessible label for the previous page button.

nextAriaLabel.description: Accessible label for the next page button.

paginationAriaLabel.description: Accessible label for the pagination nav element.

pageAriaLabel.description: (page: number) => string - Function to generate aria-label for each page button.
